#!/bin/sh
# domain-memory-pre-push
engine='{plugin}/engine'
memory='dm'
existing="$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/pre-push.domain-memory-existing" || exit 1
test -n "$DOMAIN_MEMORY_GIT_TIMEOUT" || DOMAIN_MEMORY_GIT_TIMEOUT=$(git config --get domain-memory.git-timeout) || unset DOMAIN_MEMORY_GIT_TIMEOUT
export DOMAIN_MEMORY_GIT_TIMEOUT
refs=$(cat)
tool_for_hook() {
  case "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" in
    Linux-x86_64) tool="$engine/bin/linux-x86_64/domain-memory" ;;
    Darwin-*) tool="$engine/bin/macos-universal/domain-memory" ;;
    MINGW*-x86_64|MSYS*-x86_64|CYGWIN*-x86_64) tool="$engine/bin/windows-x86_64/domain-memory.exe" ;;
    *) tool="$engine/target/release/domain-memory" ;;
  esac
  test -x "$tool" && return 0
  echo "domain-memory pre-push: no Domain Memory executable at $tool; build one with cargo build --release --manifest-path $engine/Cargo.toml" >&2
  return 1
}
tool=''
if [ -e "$existing" ]; then
  if [ ! -x "$existing" ]; then
    echo "domain-memory pre-push: the chained hook $existing is not executable, so it would not run; make it executable (chmod +x) or delete it" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$refs" | "$existing" "$@" || exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$refs" | while read local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
  test -n "$local_sha" || continue
  test "$local_sha" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" && continue
  range="$local_sha --not --remotes"
  test "$remote_sha" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" || range=$remote_sha..$local_sha
  commits=$(git rev-list $range -- "$memory") || exit 1
  test -n "$commits" || continue
  test -n "$tool" || tool_for_hook || exit 1
  printf '%s\n' "$commits" | "$tool" verify-git-governance --registry-root "$memory" --repo-root . --stdin || exit 1
done || exit 1
